summary: Confirmed nightly $35 (weekly $200, monthly $700-750), full hookups with 30/50A, WiFi, open all year, booking by phone. Added season, booking. Phone is wrong (stored 606-831-2212; operator 606-686-2267). Operator's creekside/kayak-landing claim logged as a waterfront re-audit lead. Note rewritten without field-repeating text.
flags: PHONE: 606-831-2212 -> 606-686-2267 (operator: '1 (606) 686-CAMP', contact page '1.606.686.CAMP (2267)'; Google Maps lists the same).
PRIVATE GATES: nightly RV $35 (operator home page, © 2026) - under $50. Google Maps 4.6 over 82 reviews. RV Life 5* $$ (avg $38). Presence: working operator website with phone.

LONG-STAY LEANING (workforce): 'A great place to stay for work and play!', 'Creekside has been a favorite for workers in the Tri-State and weekenders alike', monthly $700-750. Tests: 1 nightly stays sold - yes; 2 posted nightly rate - yes ($35); 3 booking - phone only; 4 nightly share - UNMEASURED (no engine; imagery shows ~35 rigs, many along the east edge and in a southern row); 5 no lot sales. Passes on the posted evidence.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (not changed): operator claims a 'creek side setting', 'CREEKSIDE FISHING' and 'KAYAK LANDING'. On z19 imagery the creek (a channel roughly 5-10 m wide, so creekside not riverfront) runs along the east edge, and the easternmost row of rigs (around 38.1703,-82.6760) sits ~20-25 m from it behind a band of mature trees; the bank height can't be read under the canopy and no site numbers are published. Could earn 'creekside' (the creekside test only needs an easy walk down) if a photo or site map shows an easy path from named sites; stays 'not waterfront' until then.
Pin 38.17033,-82.67781 sits at the entrance road junction ~145 m from the centre of the RV rows (~38.1693,-82.6768): under 250 m, left alone.
